Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

Recipe Name Deep Dish Pepperoni Cheeseburger Pizza Pie Ingredients 1. 1 lb pizza dough 2. 1 lb ground beef 3. 1 cup pepperoni slices 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 1/2 green bell pepper, diced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 10. 1 cup pizza sauce 11. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 12. 1/2 tsp oregano 13. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 14. 1/2 tsp onion powder 15. 1/2 tsp salt 16. 1/2 tsp black pepper 17. 1 tbsp olive oil Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease a deep cake pan or springform pan. 2. Press the pizza dough into the pan, covering the bottom and sides. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet and cook the onion, bell pepper, and garlic until softened. 4. Add the ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess grease. 5. Stir in pizza sauce, Italian seasoning, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. 6. Spread half of the mozzarella over the crust. 7. Spoon the beef mixture evenly over the cheese. 8. Sprinkle the cheddar and Parmesan over the beef. 9. Arrange pepperoni slices on top and finish with the remaining mozzarella. 10. Bake for 35–40 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly. 11. Let the pie rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 12. Serve hot with extra pizza sauce if desired. Cookies & Cream Oreo Ice Cream Cup! Full Recipe 👇🏿 #shorts #food #recipe  Cookies & Cream Chocolate Ice Cream Cups Ingredients Cookies & Cream Chocolate Shell 8 Hershey’s Cookies ’n’ Creme bars 8 oz white chocolate melting wafers 2–3 tbsp coconut oil Cookies & Cream Ice Cream Filling 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream 1 can (14 oz) sweetened condensed milk 15–18 Oreo cookies, roughly chopped Instructions Break the Hershey’s Cookies ’n’ Creme bars into pieces and place them in a microwave-safe bowl with the white chocolate melting wafers and coconut oil. Microwave in 20-second intervals, stirring after each interval, until completely melted and smooth. Spoon some of the melted chocolate mixture into each plastic cup. Rotate and tilt the cups until the bottoms and sides are completely coated. Place the cups in the freezer for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. Repeat the coating process until each cup has 3 solid layers of chocolate, freezing for about 10 minutes between each layer. Add the cold heavy whipping cream to a large mixing bowl and whip until stiff peaks form. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk until fully combined. Fold in the chopped Oreos until evenly distributed throughout the ice cream mixture. Spoon or pipe the Cookies & Cream ice cream filling into each chocolate cup, leaving a small amount of space at the top. Insert a popsicle stick into the center of each cup. Freeze for 4–6 hours, preferably overnight, until completely solid. Cover the top of each frozen cup with the remaining melted Cookies & Cream chocolate mixture, sealing the ice cream completely inside. Return the cups to the freezer until the chocolate shell is completely firm. To remove, briefly run the outside of each plastic cup under warm water, then carefully slide or peel the cup away from the frozen chocolate shell. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

One-Pan Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls 🔥 All the shawarma flavor, none of the extra steps… juicy spiced chicken, onion rice pilaf, refreshing salad and a creamy garlic sauce 🤌 For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp onion powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp allspice, 2 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt -3 tbsp olive oil + 8 garlic cloves -½ lemon, juiced -2 tsp bouillon (I used the roasted chicken base from @Better Than Bouillon) For the Rice: -3 tbsp butter + 1 ½ cups yellow onion, diced -1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp pepper -1 ½ cups basmati rice -3 cups hot water  -3 tsp bouillon  For the Fresh Sumac Salad: -½ large red onion, thinly sliced -1 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered -1 cup cucumber, sliced then halved -1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper & 2 tsp sumac -½ lemon, juiced For the Garlic Sauce: -¼ cup mayonnaise + ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt -2 to 3 garlic cloves + 1 tbsp fresh parsley -1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper -½ lemon, juiced + 1 tbsp olive oil 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and bouillon. Mix well. Marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside. 3. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add butter to the same pan then the onions & cook, stirring often, until translucent. Add the garlic & spices, cook for 1 to 2 mins. Add the rice and toast for 2 mins while stirring. Pour in the hot water mixed with bouillon according to package instructions. Stir & bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover & reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 mins until cooked. 4. Mix the salad ingredients in one bowl and the sauce ingredients in another bowl. Enjoy! #dinner #easyrecipe #homecooking #tiktokrecipe #fyp #shawarma #chickenrecipe #cookingathometiktoktv

videos.caption: Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Mini Cinnamon Sugar Donuts! Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 3 tbsp sugar * 110 ml milk (⅓ cup + 2 tbsp) * 1 egg * 280 g flour (≈ 2¼ cups) * 1 tsp salt * 38 g softened butter (≈ 2 tbsp + 2 tsp) Cinnamon Sugar Coating * 140 g sugar (≈ ⅔ cup) * 1 tsp ground cinnamon Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the milk, yeast, and sugar. Add the egg, flour, salt, and softened butter all at once, then mix and coil fold the dough several times. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. Coil fold again, cover, and let rise for 2 hours or until doubled in size. 2. Place your dough onto a work surface and shape it into a long log. Using a knife, cut it into 24 equal pieces. 3. Roll each piece into a ball and place it onto a small square of parchment paper. Gently flatten each one, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes. Uncover and let rest for another 5 minutes before frying. 4. Make sure the oil is hot before frying. Carefully place the donuts into the hot oil, gently remove the parchment paper, and fry until golden on both sides. 5. Mix the sugar and cinnamon together. While the donuts are still warm, coat both sides in the cinnamon sugar. #donuts #donut #bread #breadtok #homemade

Ingredients * 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts (I use thin-cut) * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * Asparagus, green beans, or broccoli Sauce * ¼ cup chicken broth * ¼ cup Dijon mustard * 3 tbsp honey * 2 tbsp olive oil * 4 cloves garlic, minced or pressed * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp dried thyme Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. 2. Place the chicken breasts in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Season both sides with the salt, pepper, and garlic powder. 3. In a small bowl, whisk together all of the sauce ingredients until smooth. Pour most of the sauce over the chicken, reserving about ¼ cup for later. Coat the chicken evenly. 4. Cover tightly with foil and bake:  * Thin-cut chicken breasts: 20–25 minutes  * Regular or thick chicken breasts (or thighs): 30–40 minutes 5. 10-15 min before chicken is done remove from the oven, add the vegetables, and drizzle the reserved sauce over the top. 6. Return to the oven uncovered for the 10-15 minutes remaining or until the vegetables are tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 7. Serve with roasted potatoes, rice, or your favorite side. Enjoy! #fyp #easydinner #recipes

Taco Mac & Cheese Ingredients * 1 lb ground beef * 1 packet taco seasoning * 4 oz tomato sauce * ½ cup salsa * 16 oz shell pasta * 1 cup beef broth * 1 cup milk * 1½ cups Mexican blend cheese, divided * Optional: parsley for topping Instructions 1. In a large skillet over medium high heat, cook the ground beef with the taco seasoning until browned and fully cooked. 2. Add the tomato sauce and salsa, and stir until combined. 3. Add the uncooked shell pasta, beef broth, and milk. Mix well. 4. Bring to a simmer, reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender. If the pasta needs more time, continue cooking and add a splash of broth or milk as needed. 5. Once pasta is cooked, stir in 1¼ cups of mexican cheese until melted. 6. Sprinkle the remaining ¼ cup cheese over the top, cover, and let it melt. 7. Top with parsley if desired and serve warm! #easydinnerideas #dinnerideas #mealideas #dinner #onepanmeal

This has definitely been added to my weekly rotation 🤤 Ingredients Chicken 4-5 chicken thighs 1 tsp black pepper  ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp smoked paprika (optional) 1/2 tsp dried thyme (optional) 1 tbsp olive oil Creamy Pepper Sauce 1/2 white onion, very finely chopped 3 garlic cloves minced  2 tbsp crushed peppercorns  1/4 tsp rosemary  150 ml chicken stock 100 ml double cream 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1 tbsp butter Salt, to taste Extra crushed black pepper, if needed Parsley chopped  Crispy Baby Potatoes baby potatoes 1–1½ tbsp olive oil Salt Black pepper 1/4 tsp dried thyme  1/4 tsp rosemary 1 tbsp butter 1/2 tsp garlic Method  Potatoes Groove the baby potatoes with a wedge cutter. Boil in salted water for 6–8 minutes, then drain and steam-dry. Toss with oil, salt, pepper and herbs. Air fry at 190°C for 15 minutes, shake, then 200°C for 5–8 minutes. Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🔥  For all of you asking about the app I made (it’s free!!) you can search “osta” on the App Store or Google Play 😁 A little sweet, a little spicy and majorly crispy… served with buttermilk ranch.  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick. Add to a mixing bowl with buttmilk, pickle juice, & chicken seasonings. Mix together. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keep the oil around this temp at all times.  4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture & stir to create flaky bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, coat each piece in the flour mixture. Shake off extra flour & place into the oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins. Fry for 7–8 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to wire rack.  6. Meanwhile, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add honey and 2–3 tbsp hot sauce and whisk until smooth.  7. Mix the ranch ingredients in a bowl.  8. Toss or brush the tenders with the hot honey sauce. Serve with buttermilk ranch & enjoy! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #recipesoftiktok #easydinner

The Arctic Fox (Vulpes lagopus), sometimes called the snow fox, is a small but remarkably hardy fox adapted to some of the coldest environments on Earth. Its thick fur changes with the seasons white during winter to blend into snow and brown or grey in summer to camouflage against rocks and vegetation. Its compact body, short ears, and furry paws help conserve heat in freezing conditions. Arctic foxes are symbols of adaptability, resilience, intelligence, and survival. They inhabit Arctic tundra across the Northern Hemisphere and can withstand temperatures far below freezing while searching for rodents, birds, eggs, fish, and carrion. Fun fact: An Arctic fox can survive temperatures approaching −50°C (−58°F), partly because its thick winter coat provides exceptional insulation. #ArcticFox #SnowFox #VulpesLagopus #Wildlife #Winter

Cook the vegan ground beef in olive oil over medium heat, breaking it into very small crumbles with a spatula. 2. Add the bell pepper, onion, and garlic and cook until softened. Season with smoked paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Stir in the tomato paste. 3. To make the sauce, combine the strained tomatoes, agave syrup, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and cook for 1 more minute. 4. One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

Chessy garlic chicken crispy rolls Ingredients  2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into small cubes 1 tsp salt, or to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tbsp paprika 1/2 tsp chili flakes 1 tsp fresh garlic, finely minced 1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 2 tbsp oil, for cooking 1 tbsp butter 3–4 garlic cloves, finely minced 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream 2 tbsp cream cheese, softened 1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 2 tbsp lemon juice  To assemble: 1 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded  5-6 flour medium tortillas  Oil for frying  Method: In a bowl, combine the chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, chili flakes ,1 tbsp lemon juice and oil. Mix until evenly coated. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat add butter . Add the chicken and cook until golden and fully done, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. During the final minute, add 1 tsp minced garlic. Pour in the heavy cream and incorporate the cream cheese, stirring until smooth and creamy. Mix until the pieces are coated in the sauce. Simmer gently for 2–3 minutes, until the sauce thickens enough to cling to the chicken. Add 1 tbsp lemon juice. Stir in the parsley. Remove from the heat and let the filling cool slightly. Warm the tortillas briefly to make them flexible. Divide the chicken filling among the tortillas and sprinkle mozzarella over each portion. Fold in the sides and roll tightly, keeping the filling enclosed. Heat a shallow layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place the rolls seam-side down first. Fry for 2–3 minutes per side, turning until golden brown and crispy all over. Let the rolls rest for 1–2 minutes before slicing diagonally. What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

The viral Brothy rice bowls are sooo savory and cozy and delish!! Made mine with a few extra veg too. Such a great dairy free dinner! Curry Broth * 3 cloves garlic, minced * 1 shallot, finely chopped * 3 tbsp red curry paste * 1 can light coconut milk * 1 cup chicken or beef broth * 3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * Oil, for cooking Ground Beef & Vegetables * 1 lb ground beef * 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * 1 zucchini, sliced * 2 cups chopped spinach * Oil, if needed Serving * 2 cups cooked rice * Garnishes: Squeeze of lime, Chili crisp, Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Heat a drizzle of oil in a saucepan. Add garlic and shallot and sauté until fragrant. Add red curry paste and toast for 1 minute. Add coconut milk, broth, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. 2. Brown the ground beef in a skillet with 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce. Add sliced zucchini and cook until softened. Add chopped spinach and cook for a few more minutes until wilted. 3. Add rice to a bowl, top with the beef and vegetables, and pour the curry broth over everything. Garnish with lime, chili crisp, and sesame seeds.

9 Best Things to Do in Marrakesh 🕌✨ 1) Stay in a Riad 🛏️  feel the authentic Moroccan vibe, from the mosaic tiles to the whisper-quiet courtyards. Riads offer privacy, fewer crowds, and a home-away-from-home feel with traditional decor, often a peaceful rooftop terrace, and staff who treat you like family. Perfect for a truly Moroccan experience without the hotel hustle. 2) Best Coffee at Bacha Coffee ☕️✨ (Location: https://goo.gl/maps/6u3Xx9J9xqv1w9Qw7) Silky espresso, perfectly balanced blends, and a chic, relaxed atmosphere. Great latte art, friendly baristas, and a bright, stylish space to post your vibes. Pro tip: try their signature crush coffee and pastry pairing. 3) Explore the Souks 🧿🌀 Fun tip: haggle with a smile, never agree to the first price! Make it a playful game, sample spices, and test your bargaining skills. Lose yourself in ribbons of color, leather, pottery, and lamps. The thrill of the find is half the fun! 4) Visit Ben Youssef Madrasa 🕌 A jaw-dropping historic site with intricate tilework, carved wood, and serene courtyards. It’s a perfect spot for photos that scream old-world Marrakech charm. 5) Jardin Majorelle 🌿💙 iconic cobalt-blue paths, lush botanical displays, and a peaceful escape from the market buzz. A must-see for color lovers and plant enthusiasts, plus it’s connected to the Yves Saint Laurent legacy. 6) Ourika Valley Day Trip 🚙🌄 about 1 hour from central Marrakech (depending on traffic). What to expect: stunning valley scenery, Berber villages, waterfalls, and a cooler climate. A refreshing break from the medina with photo-worthy viewpoints. 7) Agafay Desert Experience 🐫🏜️ Highlights: camel ride under the open sky, squad  bike moments, and magical desert views. Luxe touch: stay at a desert camp with plush lounges, gourmet meals, and starlit dinners. Perfect for a memorable  outing. 8) Dinner at La Trattoria 🍝🇮🇹  warm, cozy ambiance with authentic Italian flavors in Marrakech. Great for a relaxed evening, fresh pastas, and a lively dining vibe after a day of exploration. 9) Jemaa el-Fnaa - The Heart of Marrakech 🎭💃 Do it for the vibes: bustling square, street performances, snake charmers, and a feast for the senses. Pro tip: bring some cash for photos with performers and for quick bites. Best times: late afternoon into evening when the energy peaks. #Marrakesh #Morocco #TravelTikTok #Riads #Souks

🍪 Brownie-Stuffed Cookie Pie Ingredients Cookie Dough • ½ cup (113 g) unsalted butter, softened • ⅓ cup (67 g) granulated sugar • ½ cup (100 g) packed brown sugar • 1 large egg (50 g) • ½ tsp (2.5 g) vanilla extract • ½ tsp (2.5 g) baking soda • ¼ tsp (1.5 g) salt • 1½ cups (186 g) all-purpose flour • 1½ cups (255 g) chocolate chips Brownie Filling • ½ cup (100 g) granulated sugar • ½ cup (60 g) all-purpose flour • ½ cup (42 g) cocoa powder • 4 tbsp (57 g) unsalted butter, softened • 3 tbsp (45 g) milk • 1 tsp (5 g) vanilla extract Instructions Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Make the brownie filling by mixing the sugar, flour, cocoa powder, softened butter, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth and fudgy, then set aside. In a separate bowl, cream the softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Add the egg and vanilla extract, mixing until combined. Add the flour, baking soda, and salt, mixing until just combined, then fold in the chocolate chips. Grease an 8-inch (20 cm) round cake pan or pie dish. Press about two-thirds of the cookie dough into the bottom and slightly up the sides of the pan. Spread the brownie filling evenly over the cookie dough. Flatten the remaining cookie dough and place it over the brownie filling, covering as much as possible, then seal the edges. Bake for 25–35 minutes, or until the edges are golden and the top is set. Allow the cookie pie to cool for 30–45 minutes before slicing so the filling can set. Serve warm and enjoy! 🍫#brownies #cookies #chocolate #cookiepie #baking

videos.caption: Red Velvet Chocolate Chunk Cookies  Recipe 👇🏼 Thick, chewy red velvet cookies loaded with melted chocolate chunks.  Ingredients 2¼ cups (285g) all-purpose flour 2 tbsp cornstarch 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp baking soda ½ tsp baking powder ¾ tsp salt 1 cup (225g) cold unsalted butter, cubed 1 cup (220g) dark brown sugar 3 tbsp (37g) granulated sugar 1 large egg + 1 egg yolk 1 tbsp vanilla extract 1 tsp white vinegar 1 tbsp red food coloring 6 oz semisweet chocolate, chopped 3 oz white chocolate, chopped Directions Beat cold, cubed butter for 2 minutes until creamy. Add brown sugar and granulated sugar, then beat for another 2–3 minutes until light and fluffy. Add the egg, egg yolk, vanilla, vinegar, and red food coloring. Mix until smooth and evenly red. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined. Fold in the chopped semisweet and white chocolate, reserving a few pieces for topping. Scoop into large 4 oz (113g) dough balls and place on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Keep them tall and press extra chocolate chunks into the tops. Freeze for at least 2 hours or overnight. Bake straight from frozen at 350°F (175°C) for 16–18 minutes, placing 3–4 cookies per tray with plenty of space between them. The edges should be set while the centers remain soft. Let cool on the baking sheet for 15 minutes before transferring. Break one open while it’s still warm and enjoy all that melted chocolate! #redvelvet #cookies #chocolate #homemadecookies

hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

This chicken recipe went viral for a reason… 🤤🍗 Almost 800K views later, and we’re STILL making it every Sunday! 😂 At this point, my family just knows what’s for dinner, and honestly, nobody’s complaining! It’s easy, packed with flavor, and turns out AMAZING every single time. Served over mashed potatoes with that delicious gravy?! SO GOOD! 🤌🏼 🍗 VIRAL CHICKEN THIGHS Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 onion, sliced • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat evenly. 4. Add sliced onion, pour 2 cups of chicken broth over everything, and add fresh thyme. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 6. Remove from oven, take out the thyme, and carefully drain the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. 7. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir it into the cooking liquid. 8. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 9. Return to the oven UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes! We love serving ours over mashed potatoes with roasted green beans and honey butter rolls! 🤎 SAVE this for your next Sunday dinner! I promise it’s one you’ll make again and again! Nashville Hot Mozzarella Sticks RECIPE ⬇️ These Nashville Hot Mozzarella Sticks are extra crispy on the outside, loaded with stretchy, melted cheese, and coated in a spicy Nashville hot oil. They’re the perfect combination of crunchy, cheesy, spicy, and ridiculously addictive! INGREDIENTS Mozzarella Sticks 1 lb block mozzarella cheese 1 cup all-purpose flour 2 eggs, whisked 1–1½ cups Italian seasoned breadcrumbs Breading Seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp cayenne pepper Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 1 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp brown sugar ½ tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Pinch of salt For Frying Vegetable or peanut oil DIRECTIONS Cut mozzarella into thick sticks, about ¾–1 inch thick. Set up three bowls with flour, whisked eggs, and breadcrumbs mixed with all the breading seasonings. Coat each stick in flour, egg, breadcrumbs, then egg and breadcrumbs again for a thick, crispy coating. Make sure the cheese is completely covered. Freeze for 45–60 minutes until very firm. Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry in batches for approximately 1½–2 minutes until golden and crispy. Remove and drain on a wire rack. Combine Nashville hot seasonings in a bowl. Carefully whisk in ½ cup hot frying oil, slightly cooled, until combined. Brush the Nashville hot oil over the crispy mozzarella sticks until fully coated. Let rest for 30–60 seconds, then serve while hot for the ultimate cheese pull! #nashvillehotchicken #cheese #recipe #cooking #lunch

Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Add your reduced-fat cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, then mix everything into the hot rice until melted and creamy 6. Return to the oven uncovered for another 5–8 minutes. For a golden finish, broil for the final 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Garnish with fresh parsley, divide evenly into 6 meals, and enjoy! DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Give the chicken and vegetables a quick toss, then broil for another 2–3 minutes until slightly charred. Serve in warm tortillas with fresh guacamole, cilantro, and an extra squeeze of lime. #sivanskitchen #sheetpan #fajita #chicken #easyrecipe

Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. One Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken Bake🔥410 cals 37g protein 11g fat 40g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 meals 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 ½ cups jasmine rice, uncooked 3 cups chicken broth, warmed 1 medium yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 1 ½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved 2 cups baby spinach, roughly chopped 4 cloves garlic, minced 50g freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 tsp Italian seasoning 1 ½ tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ¾ tsp smoked paprika ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) ¼ cup fresh parsley, finely chopped Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F 2. Add chicken thigh, 1 ½ cups uncooked rice, diced onion, red bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, spinach, and minced garlic directly to the baking dish. 3. Season with 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 ½ tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ¾ tsp smoked paprika, ¾ tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, and red pepper flakes if using. 4. Pour in 3 cups chicken broth and stir everything together until evenly combined and the rice is submerged. 5. Cover the baking dish tightly with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes. 6. Remove the foil and add fresh parm and go back in the oven uncovered for another 15 mins at 400° 7. Finish with the remaining fresh parsley  Serve hot and enjoy! Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

This one starts out as a very orderly blue grid and ends up feeling like a cutaway view into a hidden room. Everything is colored with sand: the outer cube, the inner walls, and the pink floor tiles tucked into the center. It lands somewhere between pixel architecture, a tiny tiled room, and an impossible object. I especially like that it doesn’t need motion to feel dimensional. The structure does all the work. Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes.
